messages:
Priya: Putting a short follow-up from the DR postmortem. Need owners, dates, and a one-line recurrence note for each item.

Noah: I'll take restore runbook consolidation. Owner: Noah. Due: 2025-01-08. Recurrence: restore failures show metadata mismatch (ERR_RESTORE_META) ~30% of attempts.

Sam: I'll own routing weight failover policy. Owner: Sam. Ticket: ROUTE-220. ETA: 2025-01-10. Recurrence: route flaps during control-plane upgrades, usually within 5m of deploy.

Priya: Backups: enforce cross-region retention and add daily audit. Owner: Priya + BackupTeam. Ticket: INFRA-3507. Smoke restore date: 2025-01-06. Recurrence: manual snapshot deletions causing retention drift.

Noah: Runbook checklist items to add: pre-warm KV cache, cert propagation verify, and post-restore smoke tests. I'll include commands and expected outputs.

Sam: For autoscaler lag, action: reduce cooldown to 45s for critical pools and add +20% burst. Owner: PlatformTeam. Ticket: PLAT-668.

ops-bot: Channel #gd-2025-01-12 created. Calendar invite: DR game day 2025-01-12 09:00 PT. Invited: Noah, Sam, Priya.

Priya: Please post status updates as a single sentence in this thread by EOD 2025-01-05. I'll compile and close items.

Noah: ack. PR for runbook will be up by 2025-01-04.

Sam: ack. Routing PR will be ready for review by 2025-01-07.

Priya: Thanks all. Note: include grep-able log snippets in tickets so we can monitor recurrence automatically.
